goal: Reduce the JavaParserMetaModel class's direct output coupling by extracting two cohesive, dependency-heavy initialization responsibilities (property meta-model initialization and constructor-parameter wiring) into a new helper class. This moves many direct references to com.github.javaparser.ast.* types out of the target class so the target loses multiple direct external dependencies while gaining a single dependency on the new initializer class.

ops.details: Create a new final class JavaParserMetaModelInitializer in package com.github.javaparser.metamodel. Move the private static methods initializePropertyMetaModels() and initializeConstructorParameters() from JavaParserMetaModel into the new class as private static methods with identical bodies. Leave the original static fields (meta-model instances) in JavaParserMetaModel. Replace the calls in JavaParserMetaModel's static initializer with calls to JavaParserMetaModelInitializer.initializePropertyMetaModels() and JavaParserMetaModelInitializer.initializeConstructorParameters(). The new class must declare the same package and maintain access to the moved static meta-model fields by referring to them as com.github.javaparser.metamodel.JavaParserMetaModel.<fieldName> (static access) if necessary, or the extractor can make the moved methods package-private and accept no-arg calls relying on same-package visibility. Ensure method annotations (e.g., @Generated) are preserved on the moved methods in the new class.

Add imports required by the extracted methods to the new source file. At minimum add: import java.util.Optional; and the com.github.javaparser.ast types that were referenced by initializePropertyMetaModels() via fully-qualified class literals in the original method (for example: com.github.javaparser.ast.expr.AnnotationExpr, com.github.javaparser.ast.expr.Name, com.github.javaparser.ast.expr.SimpleName, com.github.javaparser.ast.type.Type, com.github.javaparser.ast.Modifier, com.github.javaparser.ast.expr.Expression). Keep the new file in the same package so it can access package-private members if needed.

In the static initialization block of JavaParserMetaModel (the existing static { ... } block), replace direct calls to initializeNodeMetaModels(), initializePropertyMetaModels(), and initializeConstructorParameters() as applicable so that initializePropertyMetaModels() and initializeConstructorParameters() are invoked on the new helper: JavaParserMetaModelInitializer.initializePropertyMetaModels(); JavaParserMetaModelInitializer.initializeConstructorParameters(); Leave initializeNodeMetaModels() in place if not moved. Ensure imports and visibility are updated so the calls compile.
